value.rationale: The original aliquot-derivative sequence has numerical values but no stated structural low-prime-complexity characterization. The theorem unconditionally forces one two-adic valuation and a parity invariant across an infinite two-prime-support domain; in the natural Omega<=2 stratum it gives a full unbounded classification, one exceptional integer, and a paired-primality criterion explaining multiple sparse examples. It does not infer infinitude or optimality and does not take credit for the known deficient-by-four shape.
